BehaviorTree.ID: Calibrate Shelf Cam From Wall Board
BehaviorTree._description: Runs stage b (Calibrate Wrist Camera On Wall Board) and then stage c: places the shelf_cam ZED 2i from the back-wall board pose that stage b just saved, since the ZED sees the same board. Saves the ZED root link pose, then runs Load Calibrated Scene, which places the shelving and publishes world to shelf_cam_camera_link. The wall board must not have moved since stage b, because this solve uses the wall pose stage b saved. Run with the picknik_009_ur5e_hw_calibration_config package so the ZED publishes full resolution. See design_docs/board_based_calibration.md.
